footer.default_tagline: The reference point for working engineers. Every step. Every unit. Every clause.

hero.heading: Measure from here.
hero.text: Compact engineering references built on worked examples, for students and working engineers who need to get a calculation right the first time. Each guide shows every step, unit and code clause, so the answer can be checked, not just copied.

featured_collection.heading: Latest revisions
featured_collection.placeholder_hint: Add products to see them here

image_with_text.heading: Checked. Referenced. Ready to use.
image_with_text.text: Each guide starts as a field problem, not a textbook chapter. It is written in plain Arabic, checked by a second engineer, and issued with a revision letter. When a standard is updated, so is the guide, and you get the new revision free.

rich_text.heading: We don't sell shortcuts. We sell the fixed point.
rich_text.text: A benchmark is a fixed mark of known elevation that every other level on a job is measured from. Each guide works the same way: a trusted reference to check your own calculation against, with a source for every number and units on every value.

testimonials.heading: What engineers say
testimonials.quote_1: The first Arabic reference I've used that matches what the consultant actually asks for on site.
testimonials.quote_2: Bought one guide, got three revisions in a year. That alone paid for it.
testimonials.quote_3: Clear numbering, clear diagrams, no fluff. Reads like a well-kept set of drawings.

faq.heading: Before you buy
faq.q_1: How do I receive the guide?
faq.a_1: Right after payment you get an email with a secure download link. The guide is a PDF and prints on A4 or US Letter.
faq.q_2: Are the guides in Arabic or English?
faq.a_2: Guides are written in Arabic. Technical terms, codes and drawing labels are kept in English where that's what you'll see on site.
faq.q_3: What happens when a standard changes?
faq.a_3: We issue a new revision and email it to every previous buyer at no cost. The revision letter on the cover tells you which version you have.
faq.a_4: Guide not what you needed? Email us within 14 days for a refund.
